probes.query: Second moments of Z^D_lambda blow up as lambda -> 1/sqrt2 in the moment method; the uniform-in-lambda control needed for a joint limit up to lambda -> 1 is not available from moment calculations.
Exponential moments of the gradient field at the level-set height are a moderate-deviation quantity outside the range of the Helffer-Sjostrand CLT.
Continuum object not defined; only the discrete energy scaling is accessible.
No analytic argument beyond diagonal kernels; the 2x2 case is the natural next target.
Need p_c(G) < 1/rho(G) or another uniform criterion for every Cayley graph of every non-amenable group.
Absence of a closed self-consistency equation on Z^3; kinetic-regime results stop at finite times.
Exact constants for the intrinsic branching structure require second-order lace expansion information.
Same as C0076 plus the sharp one-arm constant.
Polynomial growth is the Z^d problem; intermediate growth defeats the exponential-growth comparison.
No RSW-type crossing estimates for critical SAW; tightness of the observable ratio is not available.
Fine-scale dependence of the prime sums prevents the local limit theorem needed to identify the cluster structure.
Quantitative chaos rate or transversal fluctuation bound unavailable outside integrable models.
